thread.title: Qualcomm's stock surges after earnings beat, but revenue comes up shy - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Qualcomm's stock surges after earnings beat, but revenue comes up shy - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Qualcomm Inc. QCOM, +1.56% surged 2.7% in after-hours trading Wednesday, after the semiconductor and smartphone technology company reported fiscal first-quarter earnings that beat expectations, but revenue that came up a bit short. For the quarter to Dec. 30, the company swung to net income of $1.07 billion, or 87 cents a share, from a loss of $5.98 billion, or $4.05 a share, in the same period a year ago, which was negatively impacted by its dispute with Apple Inc . AAPL, +6.83% Excluding non-recurring items, adjusted earnings per share came to $1.20, the FactSet consensus of $1.09. Total revenue fell 20% to $4.84 billion, just below the FactSet consensus of $4.90 billion. CDMA Technologies (QCT) revenue declined 20% to $3.74 billion, missing the FactSet consensus of $3.80 billion, and technology licensing (QTL) revenue fell 20% to $1.02 billion, below expectations of $1.06 billion. For the second quarter, the company expects adjusted EPS of 65 cents to 75 cents, surrounding the FactSet consensus of 69 cents, and revenue of $4.4 billion to $5.2 billion, compared with expectations of $4.83 billion. The stock has tumbled 20.6% over the past three months through Wednesday's close, while the PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX, +2.87% has gained 7.1% and the S&P 500 SPX, +1.55% has slipped 0.1%.
